title: 12 Ways People Are Making $10K+/Month (That Nobody's Talking About)

idea.name: Wholesale bakery supplying local cafes
idea.one_liner: Bake in a commissary kitchen ~3 days/week and stock 20-30 independent cafes within 20 miles, won by walking in with samples and a Canva price brochure

key_quotes.quote: So, what they do is they come up with some food that they like to bake, and go to a commissary kitchen, bake those, package them, and then sell them to cafes in your area.
They then called or walked in to each of those cafes with samples, and gave them to the owners, and told them who they are and about their products.

claims.quote: They're making $24,000 a month. They're only cooking about 3 days a week in the commissary kitchen, and they just restock these 20 to 30 cafes.

acquisition_channels.details: walk-ins with samples to cafes in 20-mile radius

ideas.other_uk_rules: Food business registration, food hygiene rating, allergen (Natasha's Law) labelling for prepacked food

idea.name: Subcontracted landscaping and tree service brokerage
idea.one_liner: Sell landscaping/tree removal jobs via Google Ads to an online-booking landing page, then pass work to vetted insured subcontractors with transparent 50/50 splits
idea.revenue_model: margin on subcontracted jobs (50% landscaping, 30% tree)

key_quotes.quote: So, he'll make 50% profit on landscaping services and 30% profit on tree services.
The average cost per lead on Google Ads, he says, is $27.33 with a conversion rate of 72%.
So, if the job is $600, they know that he's charging the customer $600, and they're each going to make 300 bucks.

claims.quote: Business number two is a guy making 10 to 15,000 dollars per month selling landscaping services and then contracting them out.

acquisition_channels.details: one organic Facebook post per day, 15-20 leads/month

ideas.other_uk_rules: Waste carrier licence for green waste; tree work near highways/TPOs

idea.name: CPR training company with 1099 instructors
idea.one_liner: Ex-Marine runs CPR certification classes for healthcare staff and facilities across two states using subcontracted instructors
idea.customer: nurses, therapists, CNAs, doctors and healthcare facilities

key_quotes.quote: He quickly grew that company to now making $27 to $35,000 per month just teaching people CPR.
And so with the model that they're going towards now is they find CPR instructors in other areas and they 1099 them so basically subcontract them out like the guy in number two.

claims.quote: They're saying they have a lot more demand than they can handle right now and so it's only been a couple years and they are still growing rapidly.

idea.name: Google Ads management for % of spend
idea.one_liner: Solo operator managing Google Ads for 25 clients at ~5% of ~$20K/month spend each, with ChatGPT and scripts for reporting, growing by referrals

key_quotes.quote: Number four is a guy making $30,000 to $50,000 with 90% profit margins running Google Ads for 25 different customers.
He uses chat GPT and Google Ads scripts to get them a report really easily.

claims.quote: I think he says on average around 5% and then in return they get his time working to get their ads having a profitable return on investment and his average customer spends about $20,000 per month in ad spend.

idea.name: Local guitar and ukulele lessons
idea.one_liner: Private and group music lessons marketed with flyers at schools and coffee shops, waitlist to be monetised with digital lessons and upsells

key_quotes.quote: So he's making 2,500 dollars per week, 10,000 dollars per month in profit.
So he put flyers at schools, coffee shops.

acquisition_channels.details: flyers at schools and coffee shops, gigs

idea.name: Owner-operated dumpster rental
idea.one_liner: 20 dumpsters and one hook-lift truck rented for 3 days at $450, sold through relationships with contractors and remodelers

key_quotes.quote: Number six is the guy making $35,000 per month, $18,000 per month profit renting dumpsters.
The charge is $450 for those 3 days for the dumpster.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Skip hire needs waste carrier licence; skips on roads need council permit

idea.name: Online sewing machine repair academy
idea.one_liner: Digital course plus live Zoom group and 1:1 help teaching people to repair their own sewing machines; $579 maintenance program, 1,000+ clients
idea.offer: sewing machine repair course and coaching

key_quotes.quote: Number seven is a lady making 20 to 30,000 dollars per month teaching people how to repair their sewing machines online.
Her full maintenance program is an ongoing maintenance program, and she's charging $579 for a one-time fee.

idea.name: Rock drilling contractor
idea.one_liner: Own a single rock drilling rig and sell drilling to construction, foundation, mining, well and excavation companies; high machine cost limits competition
idea.customer: construction, foundation, mining, water well and excavation companies

key_quotes.quote: One machine, he says, can make $90,000 per month in revenue.
There's a lot of industries that you can sell your services to, and it's not super competitive just because the machines are pretty expensive.

claims.quote: He's been doing it for 4 years, and he's now making $20,000 per month in profit.

idea.name: Single Mathnasium franchise center
idea.one_liner: Husband-and-wife-run Mathnasium math tutoring franchise focused on one great location with low overhead

key_quotes.quote: Number nine is a husband and wife team who profit $20,000 per month from a math learning center called Mathnasium.

ideas.other_uk_rules: DBS checks for staff working with children

idea.name: Premium resume and career coaching service
idea.one_liner: Resume, LinkedIn, career strategy and salary negotiation at $800-1,500 for 4-6 hours; started by doing 100+ resumes free

key_quotes.quote: He typically charges $800 to $1,500 for 4 to 6 hours of work, and two to three of those are just working on fixing the resume alone, and he's been doing it for years.
To get started, he did over 100 resumes for free, helping people with their resumes for free.

claims.quote: He says he's gotten people raises from anywhere from 30 to 120 extra thousand dollars per year in their salary.

idea.name: Micro-company portfolio sharing one crew
idea.one_liner: Buy tiny businesses (lawn route from Craigslist, 4-machine vending route from Facebook, mobile mechanic) and have the same employees work across all of them
idea.offer: lawn mowing, vending, mobile oil changes
idea.revenue_model: service and vending revenue across small businesses

key_quotes.quote: What he does is buys and runs a whole bunch of little companies that add up and make him quite a bit of money.
So, he had people who were doing kind of a few different jobs for his businesses, the same employees working on both businesses.

acquisition_channels.details: buys routes on Craigslist and Facebook groups

idea.name: Custom-coded websites with monthly upkeep
idea.one_liner: Build custom-coded sites in 3-4 hours, host free on Netlify and charge a build fee plus monthly maintenance subscription

key_quotes.quote: Number 12 is a guy making $15,000 per month profit selling custom coded websites.
So, he charges a monthly subscription fee on top of the initial building fee.
